format: html

```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)
library(gsignal)
library(cli)
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
```


```{r}
data1 <- read_flapper_data(proj_path("data_dir", "RawData/ForceData/2026-11-03/FlexFin/test003.h5"))
```

```{r}
data1 <-
  data1 |> 
  mutate(fy_s.N = smooth(fy.N, t = t.s, cutoff = 5),
         fx_s.N = smooth(fx.N, t = t.s, cutoff = 5))
```

```{r}
wrap_plots(
  data1 |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = t.s, y = fy.N)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_line(aes(y = bias_fy.N, color = 'bias')) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fy_s.N, color = 'smooth')),
  
  data1 |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = t.s)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fx.N)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = bias_fx.N, color = 'bias')) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fx_s.N, color = 'smooth')),
  
  ncol = 1
)
```
